image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a white and grey electric steam iron against a plain white background. The iron features a glossy plastic body, a visible handle with an integrated trigger/button mechanism, a temperature control dial on the top rear, and a dark soleplate at the bottom. A portion of the power cord is visible extending from the rear. There is some text/logo on the side near the heel.
